'''Lidia Nikolaevna Gall''' ({{langx|ru|Лидия Николаевна Галль}}; {{nee|'''Loginova''' (Логинова)}}; 1 September 1934 – 21 October 2023) was a Russian mass spectrometrist, credited as one of the inventors for [[electrospray ionization]] source and high-performance mass analyzers.

== Life and career ==
Gall studied physical electronics at [[Peter the Great St. Petersburg Polytechnic University|Leningrad Polytechnic Institute]] and graduated in 1957. After graduation, she conducted research at the Leningrad Special Design Department. She received her PhD in 1973 from Leningrad Polytechnic Institute.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Supplementary Information and Description of Achievement - Nominating Society - Russian Society for MS - Lidija Nikolaevna Gall |url=http://www.gbmsdg.org/events/2013/Lidia_Gall.pdf |access-date=22 May 2023 |website=Greater Boston Mass Spectrometry Discussion Group}}</ref>

Gall developed ERIAD, an ionization method of liquid samples at atmospheric pressure for mass spectrometry, which is an analogue of [[electrospray ionization]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Alexandrov |first1=M. Gall was a professor at the Institute of Analytical Instrumentation of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Institute for Analytical Instrumentation >> Structure >> Laboratories |url=http://iairas.ru/en/laboratories.php |access-date=22 May 2023 |website=iairas.ru}}</ref>

Lidia Gall died on 21 October 2023, at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite news |title=Лидия Николаевна Галль |url=http://iairas.ru/news.php?q=23_10_23 |access-date=24 October 2023 |publisher=iairas.ru |date=23 October 2023}}</ref>

== Awards ==
For her contribution to mass spectrometry, Gall was awarded the Thomson Medal by the [[International Mass Spectrometry Foundation]] in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 September 2022 |title=Mass Spec in Maastricht |url=https://theanalyticalscientist.com/business-education/mass-spec-in-maastricht |access-date=22 May 2023 |website=The Analytical Scientist |language=en}}</ref> In the same year, she was awarded the Manuel Riveros Medal by the Brazilian Society of Mass Spectrometry.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 July 2019 |title=Awards {{!}} IBERO2022 |url=https://www.ibero2022.com/registration/travelgrants_awards/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220912141306/https://www.ibero2022.com/registration/travelgrants_awards/ |url-status=usurped |archive-date=12 September 2022 |access-date=22 May 2023 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
